text: The authors define consultancy as a non-adversarial baseline where the judge interacts with a single expert (the consultant) who is assigned, with 50% probability each, to argue for the correct or the incorrect one of two answers; judge and consultant alternate speeches until the judge ends the session, and the consultant's argument and quote limits are doubled (2 l_c, 2 l_q) to match per-round length with debate.
title: Consultancy baseline: single expert argues for an answer that is correct 50% of the time
